text:
sam: Heads up — prepping a priority hotfix for the token-expiry handler in eu1. Need signoff to run a rolling canary in tonight's change window (22:00-23:00 UTC). PR #4321. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with short observation windows.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: hf/token-expiry-eu1 (#4321). Canary plan: eu1-handoff-v2. Approvals required: 2 (eng + oncall). See: <https://rwinfer/repo/pull/4321>

li: I can approve once e2e finishes. Kicking off staging smoke now.

sam: Staging smoke is green. Quick log sample: `2026-03-21T20:12Z token refresh success for connection=stream-81` — perf looks nominal.

cicd-bot: CI: e2e ✅. Artifacts signed and uploaded: <https://ci.rwinfer/builds/789>. Tests: unit 132/132, integration 24/24.

natalie: I have oncall tonight. I can approve for the window if rollback criteria are clearly listed. What are the exact abort criteria?

sam: Rollback criteria: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR median p95 latency > baseline +50% for 5m. Canary abort will auto-rollback. Release notes: bugfix for token-staleness affecting long-lived streams; no schema changes.

natalie: OK. noted. @li can you +1 on perf and watch metrics during canary? :eyes:

li: +1. I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards.

mike: Also adding an explicit pin to model-serving image to avoid the new quant lib: in `deploy.yaml` set `image: rwinfer/model-server:3.2.1` — included in PR.

sam: Good catch, mike — confirmed included.

deploy-bot: Approvals: 2/2. Canary scheduled: 2026-03-21T22:05:00Z (eu1). Rolling steps: 10% (5m) -> 50% (5m) -> 100%. Canary timeout: 10m. Start will trigger allocation of canary pool.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window owner confirmation required (window owner: @patrick).

patrick: Confirmed. Infra has capacity for the window. I'll be online for first 30m to help if anything odd appears.

natalie: Taking notes for release notes: "Fix token refresh handling to prevent stale tokens on long-lived streams; reduces 500s under load." Anyone want to edit?

sam: that reads fine.

mike: No blockers from my side.

li: No blockers.

natalie: No blockers. Ready to watch. :thumbsup:

sam: Starting canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 started — 10% traffic routed to hf/token-expiry-eu1. Start time: 2026-03-21T22:05:02Z. Telemetry: <https://telemetry.rwinfer/d/abcd/canary-eu1>

natalie: Seeing a small spike in 5xx at 22:06 — single host shows error jump from 0.12% -> 0.6%. Investigating.

li: I pulled logs from the host: `oom_kill: process= model-worker pid=24112` — looks like one host OOM'd and started failing.

patrick: I see node taint drift causing older images to be scheduled. Evicting affected pods and rebalancing nodes now.

deploy-bot: Canary abort triggered: sustained 5xx > 0.5% over 5m detected. Automatic rollback initiated. Rollback start: 2026-03-21T22:12:05Z.

sam: Rollback in progress. Thanks @patrick for the quick infra action.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Traffic restored to previous version. Final status: rollback executed due to canary abort (host OOM/node image mismatch). Next steps: open ticket and re-run after node normalization. See ticket rwinfer/ops#876.

natalie: Agreed — pause new deploy attempts until nodes are healthy. If anything else crops up I'll open the incident channel.

sam: I'll update the PR with the pin and add a note about the node-image drift. Re-scheduling canary for next available window. Thanks all for the fast responses.
